cells.description: Courtyard paving seen where it meets a wall. The open interior is not art at all - perimeter-3x3 resolves to nothing there and the block fill 0x3B4753 is what covers it, which is most of what a courtyard looks like. Its ring doubled as turret cover until 2026-08-29; that is road.revetment now, so this can be redrawn as flatter paving.
cells.name: road.courtyard nw

cells.description: Directional heavy cover for a turret emplacement, the outward-bowed ring DefensePostStamper places around WEDGE and TRAPEZOID posts. Same art as road.courtyard today and cut from the same cells: the two were one block until 2026-08-29, serving as a ground surface and as cover at once, and were split so either can be redrawn without the other. Slot names read as the exterior side, which for a ring is the side facing out of the post.
